description: This file appears to be a front-end source file for rendering an HTML report viewer within a web application. It includes React components, interacts with ZIP archives using @zip.js, and manages report data loading and display logic.

classes.name: ZipReport
classes.description: A class that loads a ZIP report, extracts entries, and provides methods to access report JSON data and individual entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the ZIP report data, extracts entries, and parses the report JSON.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the loaded report JSON data.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Fetches and parses a specific entry from the ZIP report by name.
